prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Primary request: clean this generated equipment illustration into a perfectly flat, single-colour silhouette asset.
Keep the same equipment subjects, count, left-to-right arrangement and recognizable outer shapes. Reduce tiny decorative details. Preserve useful transparent holes such as windows and the centres of gears. Use one fully opaque solid foreground fill exactly #0c5952 throughout every visible object. This is flat vector-like infographic ink. Completely remove all glow, halos, gradients, texture, shaded modelling, shadows, noise, detached speckles and background. Foreground interiors must be a perfectly uniform flat RGB colour, with alpha 255 inside silhouettes; only edge anti-aliasing may be semitransparent. Background and every hole must be fully transparent alpha zero. No matte, no black background, no white background, no text or border. Leave comfortable transparent margin on every side so nothing touches a canvas edge.
original_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent raster equipment illustration for a regional briefing map.
Primary request: a generic military logistics truck on the left and a transport airplane in clear side profile on the right, nose pointing right; truck has cargo bed and distinct wheels.
Style/medium: crisp simple flat vector-style silhouettes, matching the sparse equipment silhouettes in a policy briefing infographic. Clean broad shapes, minimal negative-space details, no small decorative features.
Composition/framing: a horizontal arrangement, all subjects fully visible and separated, generous transparent margins around the artwork, subject group uses most of the width. Flat side profile, no foreshortened perspective.
Color palette: exactly one solid foreground colour #0c5952 (use that RGB hex precisely); transparent negative space and truly transparent background. No other foreground colours.
Text: none.
Constraints: isolated objects only, clean edges, genuine alpha transparency. No map, labels, text, logos, emblems, badges, frame, border, backdrop, gradient, light or dark shading, shadows, texture, white paint, horizon or ground line. Do not depict people.
source_reference: User-provided regional briefing map screenshot; equipment silhouette style only
